generation.hypothesis: Doping existing magnetocaloric materials with rare earth elements, specifically Gadolinium (Gd), will improve their magnetocaloric properties by modifying the magnetic interactions, leading to an increase in the isothermal entropy change by 20% ± 5% relative to the baseline of undoped materials. However, this improvement may come at the cost of increased material cost and potential reduced stability, highlighting the need for a thorough trade-off analysis.
